data.one_liner: An animated bottom navigation bar widget supporting floating action buttons and notches.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar widget with built-in tab animations and support for FloatingActionButton docking positions and notch smoothness. It can be used with standard icons or via a custom builder.
use_when: You want a bottom navigation bar that animates when changing tabs
You need to dock a FloatingActionButton into a notched bottom navigation bar
avoid_when: You require Material 3's NavigationBar or standard Flutter BottomNavigationBar specifications
You have more than 5 navigation elements
strengths: Smooth animations out of the box
Multiple notch smoothness and corner radius options
Supports custom builders for active/inactive states
weaknesses: Requires manual state management to drive tab changes
